region.description: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

outpost_id.description: Identifier of the Outpost to contain this endpoint.

security_group_id.description: Identifier of the EC2 Security Group.

access_type.description: Type of access for the network connectivity. Valid values are `Private` or `CustomerOwnedIp`.

customer_owned_ipv4_pool.description: The ID of a Customer Owned IP Pool. For more on customer owned IP addresses see the [User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/local-rack.html#local-gateway-subnet).
